snippet.title: Hit Others - Gameplay Video (MusicVideoGame)
snippet.description:
Take a sneak peek at the first ever MusicVideoGame! 

The new single Hit Others by Bullerslug will be released on November 1st. It's a MusicVideoGame, available as a free download for PC and Mac at http://hitothers.com/

All graphics are custom made by Jan van Nuenen and Bastiaan Bosma. In-game clothing, tattoo's, graffiti and surroundings: it's all made from scratch. Drawn by hand, scanned in and processed in the game. The band and the "Bullerbar" regulars are all based on the real Bullerslug band members.

Go to http://www.hitothers.com for more information.
